fields.name: super admin
fields.description: Full control over the CRM, including security settings, user provisioning, role assignments, global configurations, and integrations.

fields.name: admin
fields.description: Full control over the CRM, like super admin but unable to delete super admin and admins

fields.name: sales_manager
fields.description: Oversees sales pipelines, deals, and team performance across business units. Can view and edit team-owned records, manage sales quotas, and access forecasting tools.

fields.name: sales_rep
fields.description: Manages day-to-day sales operations. Full CRUD permissions strictly limited to leads, contacts, and opportunities they own. Cannot edit system-managed fields (e.g., lead score, lifecycle stage).

fields.name: marketing_manager
fields.description: Manages marketing campaigns, email sequences, segments, forms, and ad integrations. Excludes record deletions to prevent accidental removal of active sales pipelines.

fields.name: support_agent
fields.description: Handles customer tickets, cases, and communication logs. Read access to customer profile details and write access exclusively to ticket/case entities.

fields.name: auditor
fields.description: Read-only access across CRM records and report generation/export tools. Prohibited from creating, editing, or deleting live operational records.
